participant_id.Description: BIDS subject label = DANDI subject label of DANDI 000055 (sub-01 ... sub-12).

age.Description: Column "Age (years)", Table 2 "Individual participant characteristics" of Peterson et al. 2022, Sci Data 9:184, doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01280-y (CC BY 4.0); P01-P12 = DANDI 000055 / BIDS sub-01..sub-12 (electrodes.tsv rows equal surface+depth totals; ses-* count equals recording days). Paper Methods: 8 males, 4 females; 29.4 +/- 7.6 years (consistent).
